settings.heading: Just Mushrooms
settings.text: A small tincture workshop in Plettenberg Bay. Fruit body, spring water, ethanol, time.

settings.heading: Bottled on the Garden Route
settings.text:
Just Mushrooms is a small-batch tincture maker in Plettenberg Bay. We extract seven mushrooms and one Cape botanical the slow way — fruit body in spring water and food-grade ethanol — and ship the bottles across South Africa.

People come to us for a ritual they can keep: a few drops in the morning, a bitter evening Reishi, a blend that lives next to the kettle. We write the species pages so you know what you are holding. We keep the legal line in the footer, not in the headline.
